What makes a "Zorrier"? We know that "loving where you work" also means feeling empowered to do your best work One team united under an audacious mission Join the team on a mission to reimagine health benefits Most of us joined Zorro because we wanted to help fix some of the more complicated parts of the health insurance benefits system. We were looking for a place where we could take on massive industry challenges and actually see the needle move. But while the mission is what brings us together, what keeps us here is the culture and community we’ve built while doing that work. A shared goal is important, but the real reason Zorro feels different is the way this team supports, challenges, and roots for one another every single day. Zorro has been named one of Modern Healthcare’s Best Places to Work in Healthcare! In the healthcare world, this is a heavy-hitter list. Every year, Modern Healthcare looks at a range of companies across the country — from massive health systems to nimble tech startups — and selects just 150 that intentionally create a supportive employee culture. What makes this recognition feel different than a typical industry award is how the winner is chosen. It isn’t a "pay-to-play" situation or a decision made by a remote panel of judges. In fact, 80% of our score came directly from an anonymous survey our own team took earlier this year. Essentially, we won because the people who work here said Zorro is worth showing up for. What makes a "Zorrier"? When we found out we made the list, we asked the team a simple question: Why do you love working here? The answers didn't focus on the "Best Places" title itself. Most focused on the culture and community we’ve built. "What makes working at Zorro special isn’t just the work itself — it’s the people. Being surrounded by teammates who care, support each other, and push one another to be better creates an environment where you genuinely want to show up and give your best. I love it here!! Zorro helps me sparkle!" — Maureen Genskow, Account Executive That collaborative spirit is what helps us navigate the fast-paced nature of a startup. "One of my favorite things about working at Zorro is how supportive and collaborative the team is. In Customer Success, every day is different, and I enjoy being able to help clients while continuing to grow in my role.” - Keisha Eddie, Customer Success Manager For many of us, that support system turns colleagues into something more. "My favorite thing about working at Zorro is the people. Some of my teammates have become some of my best friends and it makes working here much more enjoyable." — Logan Hold, Account Executive We know that "loving where you work" also means feeling empowered to do your best work Working in an industry as complex as healthcare requires intentionality. You have to be committed to consistent growth in every step of your career journey. So we pride ourselves on creating an environment where learning is constant and autonomy is a given. "I love working at Zorro because we are set up for success. Our training and knowledge is curated to what is relevant to us at this time and what is going to help us the most. I may be biased, but our team is amazing!" — Taylor Ready, Account Executive "People make or break your experience. At Zorro, I work with the best team I have ever worked with. I'm also grateful for a very experienced leadership team that challenges me and empowers me every day. As a sales leader, I feel like I am being given the opportunity to work autonomously and build my own sub-culture within the organization." — Jeff Kirchick, VP of Sales One team united under an audacious mission At Zorro, the "mission" isn’t just a line in an employee handbook or a poster on a wall. It’s the actual gravity that keeps the team moving forward through the complexities of the healthcare system. "I spent years limited by employer group plans, and I always wondered why we let companies make such personal life choices for us. That’s why I’m at Zorro. I love being on the cutting edge of ICHRA because it brings common-sense freedom to healthcare. Plus, as a startup in a new industry, I get the unique challenge of using new tech to solve problems that literally haven't been solved before.” — Bradley Howell, Head of Customer Operations That shared sense of purpose creates an environment where people feel empowered to take ownership of the problems they’re solving. "I think what really sets Zorro apart is how aligned we are. We’re all pulling in the same direction to fix problems in the healthcare system that have been broken for a long time. That shared focus creates a lot of room to take risks and learn new things, because everyone is genuinely invested in the outcome. It’s the kind of environment where you can see the direct impact of your work every day.” — Melissa Blackerby, Senior Marketing Manager of Product & Content Join the team on a mission to reimagine health benefits Being named a Best Place to Work by Modern Healthcare is a proud moment for us, but the real win is the culture we get to experience in every stand-up or casual Slack conversation. To the team: thank you for making Zorro what it is. You are the reason we made this list. Think you’d be a good fit for our team? We’re hiring! See open roles and submit your application here. Health benefits that actually feel like a benefit “ I was hesitant about ICHRA at first, but I'm well-equipped with my Zorro-suggested ICHRA plan, which kept my GP in network and out-of-pocket costs at a minimum by matching me with coverage that aligns with my preferences. ” Plans Get the coverage that’s right for your health, your wallet, and your family Doctors & meds Family care needs Financial priorities Doctors & meds Family care needs Financial priorities Common questions, clear answers What is ICHRA and how does it work for me? ICHRA stands for Individual Coverage Health Reimbursement Arrangement. It’s a new way for employers to offer health benefits by giving you a set monthly allowance to buy your own health insurance—rather than choosing from a one-size-fits-all group plan. With ICHRA, you can shop for a plan that fits your needs, your doctor preferences, and your budget. Once you’re enrolled, you’ll get reimbursed (tax-free) for your premiums—and in some cases, other medical expenses too. Zorro makes the whole process simple, with tools to compare plans, guided support, and automated monthly payments via your virtual Zorro Pay card. We leverage advanced data analytics, unparalleled product design, and deep benefits expertise to help companies offer more flexible, affordable, user-friendly healthcare coverage. Founded by repeat entrepreneurs and supported by a brilliant team, we are seeking great talent to join our ranks. What we do: Zorro specializes in Individual Coverage Health Reimbursement Arrangement (“ICHRA”), a new type of plan changing how companies provide health benefits to their employees. Unlike traditional group coverage, ICHRA allows employers to give each employee a stipend to purchase an individual health plan of their choice. This increases flexibility, controls costs, and improves the entire benefits experience. With the most advanced platform in the industry, Zorro supports the end-to-end ICHRA journey, enabling the true customization of benefits at scale. Who we’re looking for: Zorro is looking for Seasonal Enrollment Experts to join our customer servicing and operational team. This role will focus on payment and enrollment operations with insurance carriers and client support for employees, impacting the core of our service effectiveness and client satisfaction. Availability full-time October 2026 through February 2027. Key responsibilities: Our exceptional Customer Operations team is multifaceted in its functions and responsibilities. Members of our seasonal team will work alongside them, assisting in the following areas: Primary Responsibility: Enrollment Consultation Operations: Help provide shopping guidance, assisting employees with selecting their health insurance plan. Secondary Responsibilities: Carrier Relations: Build and maintain relationships with Zorro’s network of 80+ carrier partners. Represent Zorro and ICHRA and build productive collaborations that allow us to enroll, triage and handle our growing volume of insurance enrollments. Enrollment Operations: Follow and maintain processes for enrolling Zorro members with insurance carriers. Document and build detailed instructions for each new carrier operational flow. Payment Operations: Work with clients and carriers to ensure the proper and timely processing of premium payments. Employee Support: Help with employee support operations, including knowledge documentation, chat, email, and phone support. Who you are: Operations All-Star: A true Swiss Army knife —able to move seamlessly between running large-scale processes and digging deep into audit reports to spot anomalies others might miss. Detail-Obsessed: Accuracy isn’t optional here. You thrive in the weeds, love handling complex details, and know that in financial transactions and insurance applications, nothing less than 100% precision will do. Tech-Savvy: Not just comfortable with new tools, but eager to improve processes with them. Bonus points if you’ve worked with Intercom or explored AI/agentic tools. Data-Confident: You know your way around spreadsheets, dashboards, and product outputs. Curious and Innovative: Eager to dive into a new industry, ask smart questions, and apply novel solutions to unique challenges. Startup Attitude: A self-starter with a “get-it-done” mindset. You enjoy the fast pace, adapt quickly when priorities shift, and thrive on constant challenges. Background: Active Health Insurance License A BA or current college student 1+ years of experience in customer service, data processing, or similar fields Experience in health insurance or benefits is a plus, but not mandatory.
